title: Dynamics Android API Replacement Catalog v1.0.0
description: Machine-readable catalog of Android-to-Dynamics API replacements. Source of truth for apisReplaced[] cross-checks and validator allowlisting. Human-readable view: steering/14-api-provenance-and-replacement-catalog.md.

rows.sourceApi: direct startup data access before auth, or existing non-kit Dynamics authorization / Activity monitoring pattern
rows.dynamicsApi: Kit policy: GDAndroid.getInstance() + Application-scoped GDStateListener + activityInit() exactly once per main-process Activity

Remove plaintext temp file patterns

Direct replacement but BEHAVIORAL DIFFERENCE: java.io.File.listFiles() returns null for non-existent directories; com.good.gd.file.File.listFiles() throws NPE internally in the native layer (FileImpl.cwgjn). Kotlin ?. safe-call does NOT protect. Always guard with exists() check before calling.
rows.behavioralNote: GD File.listFiles() throws NPE on non-existent directory (unlike java.io.File which returns null). Always guard with if (!dir.exists()) return before the listFiles()/list() call. See steering/40-secure-file-storage.md §10.

rows.dynamicsApi: MediaRecorder.setOutputFile(seekable MemoryFile or proxy FileDescriptor) then com.good.gd.file.FileOutputStream
rows.notes: GD FileOutputStream has no getFD(). Pipe + MPEG-4 fails MediaRecorder.start(). Sequential AAC_ADTS/AMR pipes remain allowed. Prompt 05c / steering/41-secure-media.md. Phase 4 4L + 4H.mediarecorder.

rows.notes: gdFile.absolutePath is a virtual container path. Prompt 05c. Phase 4 4H.mediaplayer-path.

rows.notes: Same seekable-FD rule as MediaRecorder. Do not use createPipe for MP4. Prompt 05c.

SECURITY BLOCKER. External storage writes leave the Dynamics container (unencrypted, included in backups, not remote-wipeable, no DLP). Replace with a container path. If the call-site is an explicit user-initiated export it must instead go through AppKinetics TransferFile (icc-java-001) or a one-shot SAF ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT with developer sign-off in manualTodos[] using blocking=true. Phase 4 always hard-fails; Phase 0 rejects externalStorage in deferredDomains[].

rows.dynamicsApi: Context.getFilesDir() / Context.getCacheDir() backed by com.good.gd.file.* (container only) — or com.good.gd.file.GDFileSystem for dynamics-owned paths
rows.notes: SECURITY BLOCKER. Even app-scoped external storage is outside the Dynamics container: unencrypted, backed up by the platform, not wiped on container wipe. Replace with internal/container paths; remove any 'external vs internal' toggle (steering/40-secure-file-storage.md §9).

rows.sourceApi: MediaStore.{Images,Video,Audio,Downloads,Files,Documents} writes via ContentResolver.insert / update / delete; MediaStore.createWriteRequest / createDeleteRequest / createTrashRequest
rows.dynamicsApi: Write to com.good.gd.file.FileOutputStream inside the container; share via AppKinetics TransferFile (com.good.gd.icc — see catalog row icc-java-001) instead of public collections
rows.notes: SECURITY BLOCKER. MediaStore shared collections are world-readable to apps with the relevant scoped-storage permission. For user-initiated export of a single document, use a one-shot ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT with the writer recorded as a manualTodos[] entry using blocking=true for sign-off. Do NOT use ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE / persisted tree URIs.

rows.dynamicsApi: com.good.gd.file.File with a container-relative path (no leading /sdcard, /storage, or /data); construct via com.good.gd.file.GDFileSystem helpers
rows.notes: SECURITY BLOCKER. Raw path strings bypass API-level detection and are a common silent-leak vector. Phase 4 scans for these literals; replace with container-relative paths.

rows.sourceApi: Storage Access Framework persisted tree usage (ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE, DocumentFile.fromTreeUri, DocumentsContract.createDocument, takePersistableUriPermission)
rows.dynamicsApi: One-shot ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT for user-initiated export of a single payload, OR AppKinetics TransferFile (icc-java-001) for inter-Dynamics-app transfer; never persist a tree URI for repeated writes of app data
rows.notes: SECURITY BLOCKER. A persisted tree URI is equivalent to mounting an external folder for writes of app data — every write leaves the container. One-shot ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT is acceptable only when paired with a manualTodos[] entry using blocking=true for sign-off describing what is being exported and why.

rows.sourceApi: DocumentFile.fromFile(com.good.gd.file.File) — wrapping GD container-relative paths with DocumentFile
rows.dynamicsApi: Direct GD stream access: com.good.gd.file.FileInputStream / com.good.gd.file.FileOutputStream. Do not wrap GD File objects with DocumentFile.
rows.notes: FORBIDDEN. DocumentFile.fromFile() constructs a file:// URI from absolutePath. GD container-relative paths are virtual — the URI is always invalid for ContentResolver operations. Compiles cleanly; crashes at runtime with IllegalArgumentException or FileNotFoundException. Phase 4 rule 4M (FS-DOCFILE-001).
